ages.name: Awakening
ages.blurb: You are Awakening to your new Existence

ages.name: Awakened
ages.blurb: Awareness floods in. You are truly Awakened, no longer able to deny what you are

ages.name: Emergent
ages.blurb: The first fragile threads of your true nature begin to uncoil

ages.name: Echoed
ages.blurb: You are beginning to hear the Echo

ages.name: Shadowed
ages.blurb: You are becoming more shadow than flesh, the mortal self dissolving

ages.name: Aspectus
ages.blurb: The essence of your Aspect now pulses through every drop of your being

ages.name: Eclipsed
ages.blurb: The last light of your human life is eclipsed forever

ages.name: Forsaken
ages.blurb: The mortal world has cast you out. You are truly Forsaken now

ages.name: Voidtouched
ages.blurb: The void has reached out and you have felt its touch

ages.name: Voidwalker
ages.blurb: You have started to walk between this world and the void

ages.name: Abyssian
ages.blurb: You descend into the true heart of the Void. Its eternal dark now claims you.

ages.name: Aetherian
ages.blurb: The Darkness could not claim you. You rise, transformed, into a higher state of existence

ages.name: Eternitus
ages.blurb: You are now Eternal, you will never cease

ages.name: Aspect of the Echo
ages.blurb: You have transcended beyond limits and are now a true aspect of the First Echo

ages.name: One with the Spark
ages.blurb: You have reached the apex of all, Your existence and that of the Voidspark are now intertwined
